description.value:
As an Action, you or your bonded familiar awaken the power of your chosen season in a 30-feet radius sphere around a point you can see within 60 feet, affecting creatures of your choice in the area in the following ways for 1 minute.

Either of you can dismiss this effect as a Bonus Action and only one instance of the effect can be active at a time.

Spring. An affected creature regains additional hit points equal to your spellcasting ability modifier when healed.

Summer. An affected creature that starts its turn in the area or enters it for the first time on turn, its Speed is increased by 10 feet. Additionally, the area is brightly lit. This light counts as sunlight.

Autumn. Healing on affected creatures is halved.

Winter. The area is 3 for affected creatures.
